Two slices of white toast come to about 160 kcal. The orange juice is roughly 200 ml, about 90 kcal. The Brownes strawberry yoghurt is a 170 g tub, about 160 kcal. The two peanut butter portions are about 11 g each, so roughly 130 kcal together.

That puts the served total at about 540 kcal. I assumed the person eats most of it and leaves about 40 kcal.
